policy: Required and optional edges apply only under their when condition. Current authorization, client tools and invocation restrictions remain authoritative. Do not recursively preload the graph.

ui-craft.when: Before claiming the edited UI or interaction works.
When the target is a React Native/Expo interface rather than a web page.

build-sequencer.when: When an implementation task reaches verification; not for a plan-only request. Or: Before reporting the implementation as working.
When an unresolved product choice changes the implementation.
When the feature contains durable Temporal workflows.
When the requested deliverable includes Terraform modules.
When implementing a React Native/Expo feature.
When the finished plan should be published as Gitea issues with a roadmap.
For the explicitly requested test-first implementation flow.
For the final code review specified by this implementation flow.

roadmap-slicer.when: When an open product decision changes the breakdown and investigation cannot settle it.
When the plan lacks an ordered change sequence or acceptance criteria to slice from.

bug-tracer.when: Before claiming the reproducer is fixed.
When the observed defect is a measured performance regression.
When diagnosis depends on the pinned dependency implementation.

behavior-proof.when: When verifying Python Temporal replay, timers or determinism.
When the client permits terminal browser QA and no more specific browser contract takes precedence.
Only when the user asks to ship changes after the read-only readiness assessment.

diff-inspector.when: When changed documentation may disagree with implementation.

mcp-server-forge.when: Before claiming the server/tool contract works.
When client registration, initialization or tool discovery needs diagnosis.
When implementing the server in Go.
When implementing a TypeScript server contract.

postgres-workbench.when: Before claiming migration, compatibility or rollback success.

git-surgery.when: When PR checks need diagnosis or an authorized wait for completion.

primary-source-notes.when: For the final source-to-claim check on the research note.

market-position-map.when: When finding or refreshing public competitor sources.
When the user also requests comparison-page copy from the researched profiles.
When the user also requests sales battle cards.

editorial-roadmap.when: When an approved written voice must guide the editorial plan.
When existing assets need adaptation into the planned channels.
When the requested roadmap depends on a search-content audit.

writing-workbench.when: When matching a supplied writing sample is requested.

story-workbench.when: When the diagnosed problem concerns character motivation or development. Or: When the diagnosed problem concerns dialogue. Or: When a drafted scene fails the established character arc. Or: When a dialogue pass is needed. Or: When a conventional beat needs alternatives. Or: When the draft reaches sentence-level revision. Or: When requested alternatives focus on dialogue.
Before delivering drafted prose; preserve the fiction voice. Or: Before delivering generated prose; preserve the writer's voice.
When new material must be checked against persistent canon.

story-dna-extractor.when: When the studied book needs structural interpretation beyond the scene inventory.
When turning the analysis into a multi-session craft study plan.

rpg-game-master.when: When running a persistent setting with recorded canon. Or: When tracking consequential changes across sessions.

world-bible.when: When the requested canon work includes constructed-language design.

lesson-workspace.when: Before claiming course lint and exercise checks passed.

rn-expo-builder.when: Before claiming mobile behavior works; honor the current client's device-tool contract.
When the feature adds login or access checks.
When list, animation or startup performance has a measured problem.

fleet-ops-router.when: Before claiming validation, plan or Terratest results.
When the module work includes authorized secret delivery or rotation.

temporal-workflows.when: When workflow evolution changes persisted application data.
When a failure or replay mismatch needs isolation.

pptx-forge.when: When slide structure needs to communicate supplied quantitative evidence.
When adapting the slide story into a spoken script.
